Highly recommended! Heena Singh 04/06/2025 View More Reviews Write a Review How It Works Step 1 Reduction in Frizz Oleic acid controls water loss in the hair strands & makes it soft and more pliable. The negative charge of the damaged and frizzy hair attracts the positively charged molecules present in the silicone that neutralizes the electrical charges and diminishing frizz and friction. Dimethicone has the effect of protecting the hair shaft from abrasive actions. Step 2 Hair Nourishment Argan oil and olive oil contain a wide variety of phytochemicals which have desirable nutritional properties. Oleic acid and Vitamin E provides a fatty layer to your hair that helps prevent dryness and provides the required nutrition to your hair. It also boosts hair’s elasticity and shine. Step 3 Protection from UV rays & heat damage Forms a protective layer of lipids that have a higher smoking point. It protects the hair strands from heat damage caused by the styling tools & UV rays. Questions you should be asking. Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Hair Strengthening Serum What is Hair Serum? Hair serums are designed to make your hair more manageable and less frizzy. The ingredients of Hair Serum penetrate through your hair strands to detangle your hair, add shine, and repair damage. Hair serums are also known to protect and strengthen hair against heat damage. Is serum good for my hair? Hair serum is good for your hair. Using the Hair Serum prevents dry hair to a great extent and acts as a quick fix to frizzy hair and restores your hair's natural shine. Will Hair Serum help me manage my frizzy hair? Yes, using the Be Bodywise Hair Serum can help manage your frizzy hair. It is enriched with the benefits of argan oil, jojoba oil and sunflower oil. Should I apply this Hair Serum before styling my hair or after? It is recommended to use this Hair Serum before using any other styling tools on your hair. Can I apply this Hair Serum on dry hair? For best results, it is suggested to use this Hair Serum after washing your hair. Will this serum make my hair oily? This hair strengthening serum is lightweight with a non-sticky texture. Hence, it will not make your hair oily. It prevents dry hair and makes your hair non-frizzy and manageable. Does this Hair Serum have any side effects? There are no recorded side effects of this Hair Serum. It is recommended not to apply the product on your scalp, but on your hair strands.
